@graph.name: Construction Workforce Recruitment India | EarlyJobs
@graph.description: Hire site support, trades and project administration staff for construction and infrastructure projects across India with EarlyJobs.

mainEntity.name: Can EarlyJobs support construction workforce recruitment?

acceptedAnswer.text: EarlyJobs helps EPC and infrastructure employers assess site assistants, trades, equipment support and project admin hiring. Share project belts, mobilisation dates and accommodation context so candidates understand on-site conditions.

mainEntity.name: Can companies request hiring across project sites?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Multi-site employers can provide location-wise vacancies, trade mixes and peak manpower windows. Separating civil, MEP and finishing trades avoids mismatched applicant pools.

mainEntity.name: What information is needed for project hiring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vacancy numbers, site GPS or district, trade certifications required, compensation, work rotation and reporting dates help scope recruitment. Employers remain accountable for site safety briefing and statutory compliance.
Employers must deliver site induction, PPE allocation and trade-specific safety authorization. EarlyJobs does not replace contractor obligations under applicable construction safety regulations.
